input.prompt: An authentic Srikalahasti kalamkari hand-painted cotton textile panel, a sibling of the reference image: match its exact palette, kalam line quality, dotted and cross-hatched fill patterns, visible cotton weave and its lotus-and-vine border. Photographed flat and straight-on so the cloth fills the entire frame edge to edge. The ground of the panel is undyed ecru cotton. SCENE, exactly two people: a young Telugu man and a young Telugu woman sit cross-legged on a patterned madder-red mat, facing each other in side profile under a blossoming tree, both mid-conversation with one hand raised in an open, expressive talking gesture. The man (left) has short black hair, a neat short black beard and thin round spectacles, and wears a plain kurta with a dotted indigo pattern. The woman (right) has long black hair in a single braid down her back, and wears a madder-red saree with a yellow border and fine dot pattern. Both drawn in the classical kalamkari manner: large almond eyes, gentle smiles, stylised hands with five slender fingers, flowing patterned drapery. From the space between their faces, two slender curling botanical vines rise upward, one from each of them, spiralling around each other and intertwining, then joining into a single large blooming lotus flower directly above their heads. Above, the tree's curling branches spread across the top with lotus blossoms, paisley leaves and buds; on one branch two green parrots perch facing each other, each with one foot raised, mirroring the couple's pose. A small band of stylised flowering ground beneath the mat. A dense ornamental border runs around all four edges: a lotus-and-vine scroll on madder red between two thin dotted bands, identical in style to the reference. Style: freehand kalam (bamboo pen) outlines in iron-black with confident, slightly irregular line weight; flat natural vegetable-dye fills only: deep madder red, brick red, indigo blue, myrobalan-turmeric yellow, green from indigo over yellow, and undyed ecru cotton; dense hand-drawn fills of dots, cross-hatching, scales and tiny petals; slight dye bleed at colour edges. Completely flat, no perspective, no shading, no gradients, no metallic gold, no 3D, no photorealism. The vines are purely botanical, with leaves and tendrils only. No text, no letters, no script, no writing, no numbers, no speech bubbles, no lamps, no diyas, no candles, no fire, no flames. Exactly two human figures.
